name: Auth0 for AI Agents
summary: Okta's Auth0 product set for agent apps: user login, a Token Vault that stores and refreshes third-party OAuth tokens on the user's behalf, asynchronous approval (CIBA) for sensitive actions, and fine-grained authorization for RAG. Auth for MCP went GA in May 2026.
facts: User auth, Token Vault, async authorization (CIBA), FGA for RAG, Auth for MCP
35+ prebuilt integrations, any standard OAuth service
LangChain/LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Vercel AI SDK, Cloudflare Agents
Free plan includes two Token Vault connected apps
goodFor: Agents calling Google, Slack, GitHub etc. on a user's behalf
Human approval of high-risk actions out of band
watchOut: Several pieces are still early access or developer preview
Ties agent identity to the Okta/Auth0 platform
